summary: Koochiching County, MN ladder tower dated 1938 to the Minnesota Forest Service; county list says removed, with no removal date or site description found.

facts.design: Ladder-type tower; four-legged steel structure with an enclosed observation at the top (1959 survey note)
facts.status_note: County list marks the tower removed, with no removal date; FFLA also lists it as gone

events.note: Dated 1938 in both the county and statewide lists; owner shown as Mn MFS

resolved_conflicts.explanation: County and statewide tables list 80 feet; the 1959 survey note says approximately 100 feet. The record keeps the table figure and the story reports both.

sources.title: Koochiching County Minnesota Fire Lookout Towers

notes_for_editor: Only survey-list entries and the FFLA listing describe this tower; no narrative or site source was found. The 1959 note (about 100 ft) conflicts with the 80 ft table value. The removal date is unknown, so there is no removed event. Site condition and access are not described anywhere we read, so access is omitted. Brief status 'gone' is confirmed by both lists.
